result.summary:
REQ-VALIDATOR round 3 verdict: FAIL. All 11 round-2 findings (N1-N4, M-a..M-g) are resolved. ORCH's parallel-runs design (criteria 14-15) is executable and keeps AP-007's core. Four gaps must be closed first: R1 and R2 are blocking, R3 and R4 required. All are small and local to criteria 5, 6, 14, 15 and 17. Research (step 1) must not start. Re-validation: step-00b-req-validator-r4.json.
Criteria are cited by number. I checked the REQ-006 block through the requirement's own awk (Б) on a frozen copy and on the live file. Both give 84caa600... at 16:39Z and at 16:51Z; the live file has been unchanged since 16:36:02Z. Lines 1-158 are b41b4742..., equal to the analyst's record. Lines 1-159 are byte-identical to round 2: I rebuilt the round-2 file from my saved text, and its hash matches my round-2 snapshot.

ROUND-2 FINDINGS
N1 resolved as I specified in round 2. AC4 binds each command to its input and step, and AC17 scopes step 3 to «4 (часть для шагов 3 и 4) и 7-13». Test: in «рано», with L from jq on a 2a handoff, wc -l = 1, 1 terminal mark and 5 of 5 strings; headings are taken from 2b. The remaining «рано» gap is R4: my round-2 fix did not cover the table.
N2 resolved. «план владельца»: 0 hits; «план ORCH, одобренный владельцем»: 3. Every other «владел...» phrase says who decides or cites a recorded rule with its file (WF-06:24 and orchestrator.md:35, both verified).
N3 resolved. AC6 and AC18 define -runN. jq -s on a synthetic 2a/2b set (an interrupted run, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, then FAIL) gives 1 value_sentence, 1 PASS/FAIL and SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE <= 1.
N4 resolved. AC5 adds SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE and result.unopened; a second SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE leads to blocked «источник недоступен»; the Q10 sentence is updated. Small wording issue: S3.
M-a resolved: WF-07 lines 6, 20, 37, 44, 46, 48, 85, 86 match grep, and step 5 is in AC16. M-b resolved: the anchored grep gives 1; the one-line rule and context.task_check are in place. M-c resolved: LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 on AC9 and AC12. M-d, M-e, M-f and M-g resolved; the AC8 reasons grep -cF per line gives 1,1.
Word-level diff r2 -> r3: every change is in the analyst's list. The only unlisted one is AC7 «step-02a» -> «handoff-а 2a», which is consistent with N3.

PARALLEL RUNS (criteria 14-15): JUDGMENT
Executable. I extracted every command literally from the parsed text and ran it with system binaries in bash, and again with the zsh ugrep/bfs wrappers other agents get. The results were identical.
- З: 30 lines (23 mandates, README, 3 research files, 1 review, WF-07, snapshot.js), identical to the independent find+shasum listing. A tampered hash gives 2 diff lines; a new .claude/agents file gives 1.
- snapshot-diff (npm in zsh and node in bash) with a synthetic ISS-0001 + PO declaration file: main command exit 0; control exit 1 with exactly the 3 «added» output lines; an undeclared change (docs/quality-bar.md) exits 1.
- Criterion 15 jq: shape is true/false as intended, including for an empty file. Order rejects a backdated append. The prefix hash survives a legitimate append and changes when a pinned line is edited. Intersection: 0 for good declarations; tools/src/ 1, tools/src/snapshot.js 1, .claude/ 1, docs/ 9, docs/business-plan/research/ 5, handoffs/ 1. A path without the trailing slash or with a «./» prefix scores 0 and also allows nothing in snapshot-diff, so the two checks agree.
- Б is stable when REQ-001 is edited, when REQ-007 is appended, with trailing blank lines and with whitespace-only lines. It changes on the REQ-006 status flip, on a 1-character AC edit, on deleting a criterion and on an injected comment.
AP-007's core is kept: the snapshot is still taken before step 1, З and Б are checked without tools/, and every undeclared change still fails step 4. ISS-0001 already changed the snapshot-diff read path in tools/src/cli.js today (existsSync -> readTextFile). The behaviour is equivalent, but it confirms the measuring tool is edited mid-run (Q6), so S1 matters. This is not a lowering of the bar.

NEW FINDINGS
R1 BLOCKING, testability — criterion 14 (а)/(в), Б. There is no non-empty guard.
 - Criterion 14 runs npm from tools/ and then Б «из корня». Run from tools/, Б prints only «awk: can't open file docs/requirements.yaml» on stderr, and the pipeline exits 0 with e3b0c442..., the sha256 of empty input.
 - A CRLF-converted file gives the same hash.
 - If ORCH records that value and RELEASE-VALIDATOR repeats the step, the check passes having compared nothing. Since docs/requirements.yaml is now declarable, Б is REQ-006's only protection.
 Fix: record context.req006_block_lines (awk | wc -l; 143 today); require it to be > 0 and the first line to be exactly «  - id: REQ-006». State that e3b0c442... means the command failed, not a value, and that Б runs from the sai root (or with ../docs/requirements.yaml from tools/).
R2 BLOCKING, consistency / AP-007 regression — criteria 14-15 vs the description («как у исследований REQ-005 (критерий 2)») and criterion 10 («как REQ-005, критерий 4»).
 - REQ-006 imports REQ-005's criteria 2 and 4 as its research-format and sourcing rules. In round 2 they were protected, because nothing in docs/requirements.yaml could change.
 - Now the PO run declares the whole file (ORCH ruling 3). Demonstrated: changing REQ-005 criterion 4 («любое другое число помечено «допущение»» -> «...допустимо без пометки») leaves Б unchanged (84caa600...), and snapshot-diff exits 0 with the declared path. A mid-run relaxation of the rules REQ-006 imports would pass silently.
 Fix: protect the REQ-005 block the same way — the same awk with REQ-005 (33 lines; the hash changes on that edit), recorded as req005_block_sha256 and _lines and checked at step 4.
R3 REQUIRED, AP-007's purpose — criterion 15.
 (a) A declaration needs no evidence that it is a separate run. run_id is free text, and the only timing check applies «если такая папка есть». So any unprotected path can be excluded from step 4 by one appended line, including a post-snapshot fix made for REQ-006 itself, which AP-007 routes to a new BP-ID or the owner's exception.
 Fix: each line also names what the run serves (field «for»: REQ/ISS id or decision, never REQ-006). If handoffs/<run_id>/ exists, its handoffs must name that id and never REQ-006 in context.requirement_ids; check with jq.
 (b) A run's own handoffs/<run_id>/ is not required among its paths. Measured: with the runs declared without their handoffs folders, step 4 exits 1 on the runs' new handoffs, which forces a restart for a bookkeeping slip. ORCH's description of ISS-0001 (step-00a-r3 parallel_work_now, ruling 2) already leaves it out.
 Fix: RELEASE-VALIDATOR adds --allow handoffs/<run_id>/ for every declared run_id, or criterion 15 requires it in paths.
R4 REQUIRED, testability/consistency — criteria 4, 5, 6 and 17 in the «рано» outcome.
 (a) 2c overwrites the 2a file, so the competitor table is lost. RELEASE-VALIDATOR, which «сам пересматривает вердикт по таблицам покрытия» (criterion 5), cannot re-check the table-based FAIL conditions 4-6 or criterion 4's table rules. «Рано» is irreversible, so this re-check is the only independent safety net (Q2).
 (b) If RELEASE-VALIDATOR's re-review contradicts the 2b verdict in either direction, no path exists. 2b has no rework (criterion 6: exactly one PASS/FAIL), and step-3 reworks cannot touch the value line (criterion 7), so criterion 17's «не больше двух доработок» can never end.
 Both have been latent since round 2 (B2), and my round-2 N1 fix left out the table; I missed them.
 Fix: the 2a handoff stores the table verbatim (result.value_table), and 2b stores its own command outputs (result.checks, which is also Q2 evidence). In «рано», step 4 re-runs criterion 4's table command on result.value_table. A step-4 contradiction of the 2b verdict sets REQ-006 to blocked «вердикт ворот оспорен», and both verdicts go to the owner. There is no 2b rework, so the B2 ruling stands.

SHOULD-FIX (small, same pass)
S1 Criterion 14 control exercises only the «added» branch of snapshot-diff, while cli.js and util.js stay editable. Add a «changed» control: a scratch copy of the before snapshot with one undeclared file's hash altered must give exit 1 and exactly that «changed» line (tested: exit 1, «changed docs/owner-goals.md»). Add a «removed» control too.
S2 Criterion 14 (а): add pixel-office-brief to the before-snapshot grep, so the premise of the «added» control is guaranteed (today: 0).
S3 Criterion 5: «...-run2.json» -> «...-runN.json», because an interrupted 2b may already have taken -run2 (criterion 6).
S4 Criterion 15: (.declared_at|length) == 20 does not check the format; use test("^\\d{4}-\\d\\d-\\d\\dT\\d\\d:\\d\\d:\\d\\dZ$").
Note, not a defect: Б drops whitespace-only lines, so a change from "" to "   " inside the description goes undetected. This is harmless for the folded text.

ON ORCH'S RULINGS (context.orch_rulings_on_analyst_questions)
(1) tools/ stays editable, with З checked independently plus a positive control: acceptable. З and Б do not depend on tools/; with S1 added, a changed tool can cause a false FAIL but hardly a false PASS.
(2) ISS-0001 declared file by file: consistent (tools/src/ scores 1 in the intersection check). Its declaration must also carry handoffs/ISS-0001-20260930-01/ — see R3(b).
(3) The PO run declares docs/requirements.yaml: workable only with R2. Operational note: ORCH's in_progress flip must not overlap a PO write; Б would catch a lost flip at step 4 (FAIL, not silent).
jsonl: fine.

- The literal commands were extracted from the parsed criteria 14-15 (Б awk, З grep, find, 3 jq programs) and run as described above: fresh snapshot of 212 files; З 30 lines = find 30 lines (diff empty); before-grep 0; snapshot-diff main, control, undeclared change, missing handoffs folders and «changed» control; npm exit-code propagation in zsh; the criterion 15 jq suite; Б variants a-j; Б run from tools/.

Tree diff since my round-2 snapshot: requirements.yaml, those tools files and the new handoffs.
